title: KC Concepcion has 129 yards, Browns lead Titans 17-14 at halftime

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: KC Concepcion has 129 yards, Browns lead Titans 17-14 at halftime
sources.description: The Browns got down early, but have been able to claw their way back against the Titans to take a 17-14 lead at halftime.
